camera: Flat front-facing UI; a shop grid of offer buttons. No 3D previews.

hudLayout.topThird: Full-width header: top-left tilted leather chapter book with gold numeral and CHAPTER; three dark inset counters (gold hexagon coin, green star XP, magenta meeple henchmen) with numbers; four-segment progress bar with amber fraction at right. Below, a polished dark-wood band with the parchment quest scroll sealed in red wax. Then a khaki title bar with a pale-brown title word at left and a crimson square X close button at right. Under it a full-width amber raised banner button (~9% of height) with a wooden treasure chest icon at left and a large bold cream headline.
hudLayout.middleThird: A 3-column grid of raised square-ish offer buttons, rows colour-coded: row 1 royal purple (card pack icon with a stacked big number and 'CARDS', a 'Buy for ... Gold' line beneath), row 2 lime olive (glossy green star icon, big number and 'XP', price line), row 3 sky blue (gold-and-copper pocket-watch/clock icon, big number and 'HOUR'/'HOURS', price line).
hudLayout.bottomThird: Rows 4 and 5 amber (dark leather coin-pouch icon, big number and 'Gold', real-money price line). Below the grid a black empty band (~9% of height), then the dark-wood bottom bar with a hero-card stack icon left of centre, a wooden chest with a yellow '!' at right and a steel cog at far right.

keyElements: chapter book, three counters and progress bar header
Shop title bar with crimson X
full-width amber 'Get FREE Loot!' banner with chest
3x5 grid of colour-coded offer buttons (purple cards, lime XP, blue time, amber gold x2 rows)
each offer: icon left, big amount right, price line below
wood bottom bar with card stack, chest '!', cog
uiStyle: Chunky soft-slab 9-slice raised buttons in purple, lime olive, sky blue and amber, each with a lighter rounded bevel rim, a darker warmer front lip and a small warm glint at the top-left; bold cream/white display type; glossy painted icons with thin self-coloured rims. Crisp programmatic engine chrome.
colorPalette: Wood-brown and khaki chrome top and bottom, a saturated jewel-tone block grid in the middle stepping purple → lime → sky blue → amber, against a flat black backdrop that is the main thing that reads unfinished.
mood: Bright, generous merchant counter — clear offers, easy reading.
composition: The full-width amber free-loot banner leads, then a strict 3x5 grid whose colour bands group offers by type; even gutters and identical internal layout make it scan row by row.
